hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_MESSAGE" | grep -qi "flaky\|timing out\|intermittent"; then echo "🧪 Consider using e2e-reliability-marshal for test reliability issues"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_MESSAGE" | grep -qi "connection\|websocket\|socket"; then echo "🌐 Consider using websocket-resilience-officer for real-time connection issues"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_MESSAGE" | grep -qi "schema\|prisma\|dto\|type"; then echo "🔗 Consider using api-contract-sentinel for API contract validation"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_MESSAGE" | grep -qi "ui\|material\|styling\|button"; then echo "🎨 Consider using material-tailwind-guardian for UI consistency"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_MESSAGE" | grep -qi "cors\|auth\|security\|jwt"; then echo "🔒 Consider using security-hardening-officer for security review"; fi
